summary:
## Changes

* Add distanceSq by @AlexAPPi in #9313

* Replace batch.origMeshInstances[0] with sourceMeshInstance variable by @AlexAPPi in #9454

* Support stencil clears inside a render pass on WebGPU by @mvaligursky in #9612
* Allow camera viewports extending past the render target on WebGPU by @mvaligursky in #9516
* Add partial vertex and index buffer uploads by @mvaligursky in #9401
* Add screen_size to forward view uniforms and deprecate uScreenSize by @mvaligursky in #9331
* Pack forward view uniforms to reduce alignment padding by @mvaligursky in #9332
* Move per-pass uniforms into the view uniform buffer by @mvaligursky in #9582
* Move textureBias into the view uniform buffer by @mvaligursky in #9484
* Supply per-pass textures through the WebGPU view bind group by @mvaligursky in #9521
* Publish the scene environment textures under their own uniforms by @mvaligursky in #9364
* Add an opt-in std140 packing order to UniformBufferFormat by @mvaligursky in #9400
* Stop creating typed array views for every dynamic uniform buffer update by @mvaligursky in #9418
* Retain WebGPU render pipelines between draws by @mvaligursky in #9380
* Look the WebGPU render pipeline up only when its state changes by @mvaligursky in #9492
* Write WebGPU buffer data directly from its storage by @mvaligursky in #9379
* Pass WebGPU bind group dynamic offsets as a typed array by @mvaligursky in #9487
* Skip WebGPU vertex and index buffer binds the render pass already has by @mvaligursky in #9496

* Assign bind group slots by index during the update by @mvaligursky in #9425
* Split the bind group update into a scope path and an owner path by @mvaligursky in #9429
* Leave a texture out of the mesh bind group when a supplied group has it by @mvaligursky in #9436
* Let the graphics device own the built-in textures by @mvaligursky in #9438
* Rebuild layer mesh arrays lazily after removals by @mvaligursky in #9378
* Pack the mesh instance light mask into 8 bits, for 24 shader define flags by @mvaligursky in #9617
* Rename supportsUniformBuffers to usesMeshBindGroups by @mvaligursky in #9383
* Split WebGPU device creation from device initialization by @mvaligursky in #9483
* Ignore MeshInstance#setIndirect where indirect draw is not supported by @mvaligursky in #9462
* Remove obsolete immediate mesh rendering by @mvaligursky in #9385
* Remove the shader dump and precompile workflow by @mvaligursky in #9477
* Remove obsolete Mac Chrome blitFramebuffer workaround by @mvaligursky in #9318
* Remove obsolete Safari texture unit workaround by @mvaligursky in #9319

## Lighting & Shadows

* Move light uniforms into the view uniform buffer, uploaded once per pass by @mvaligursky in #9482
* Give every light an absolute slot, shared by all light masks by @mvaligursky in #9475
* Dispatch the lights of a pass once, not per light mask by @mvaligursky in #9479
* Consolidate light slots into a LightList shared by renderer, shaders and lightmapper by @mvaligursky in #9481
* Make world-cluster allocation request/execute based by @mvaligursky in #9473
* Fade directional shadows at the far distance by @mvaligursky in #9417
* Skip shadow sampling beyond the far distance by @mvaligursky in #9419
* Request directional shadow culling from scheduled render passes by @mvaligursky in #9423
* Request local shadow culling from scheduled render passes by @mvaligursky in #9428
* Cull only requested directional shadow cascades by @mvaligursky in #9437
* Skip spot VSM blur when the shadow pass does not execute by @mvaligursky in #9440
* Set shadow caster material state once per material run by @mvaligursky in #9524
* Derive the normal matrix of shader materials in the shadow pass by @mvaligursky in #9585
* Give a mesh instance lightmap its own texture slot by @mvaligursky in #9415
* Bind only the lightmap slots a bake writes by @mvaligursky in #9420
* Fix shadow shader selection when changing cascade count by @mvaligursky in #9343
* Reset clustered shadow lights before preparing each frame by @mvaligursky in #9414
* Fix WebGPU shadow shader compile error for PCSS spot lights by @mvaligursky in #9545
* Pass an empty LightList, not 0, to the shadow pass shaders by @willeastcott in #9556
* Hidden mesh instances with culling disabled no longer cast shadows by @mvaligursky in #9606

## Materials

* Add a material bind group slot and cached shader processing keys by @mvaligursky in #9370
* Hold the textures of a material in its own bind group by @mvaligursky in #9457
* Bind the material bind group at a material switch instead of at every draw by @mvaligursky in #9413
* Store StandardMaterial diffuse in a material-owned uniform buffer by @mvaligursky in #9381
* Store emissive color and intensity in the material uniform buffer by @mvaligursky in #9392
* Store the remaining StandardMaterial colors and numbers in the material uniform buffer by @mvaligursky in #9398
* Store the derived StandardMaterial uniforms in the material uniform buffer by @mvaligursky in #9402
* Store the texture map transforms in the material uniform buffer by @mvaligursky in #9405
* Store the cube map projection box in the material uniform buffer by @mvaligursky in #9406
* Copy the cube map projection box into the material instead of keeping a reference by @mvaligursky in #9411
* Support mesh instance overrides of material uniform buffer values by @mvaligursky in #9386
* Let a mesh instance override a texture of the material bind group by @mvaligursky in #9445
* Restore global scope values after mesh instance parameter overrides by @mvaligursky in #9588
* Warn in debug builds when a mesh instance override array changes in place by @mvaligursky in #9395
* Warn about material and mesh instance parameters of view uniforms by @mvaligursky in #9619
* Add support for all eight UV sets in StandardMaterial by @mvaligursky in #9376
* Make alphaTest an accessor of Material and retire the generic float property helper by @mvaligursky in #9408
* Separate sprite color from material uniforms by @mvaligursky in #9337
* Separate UI element colors from material uniforms by @mvaligursky in #9338
* Pass the model scale to dynamic refraction from the vertex shader by @mvaligursky in #9616
* Fix LitMaterial ambient by making the ambient tint a lit argument by @mvaligursky in #9538
* Fix StandardMaterial shader invalidation for environment textures and 0/1 number changes by @mvaligursky in #9359
* Fix StandardMaterial shader invalidation for refraction thresholds by @mvaligursky in #9363
* Make StandardMaterial texture map iteration ignore prototype properties by @mvaligursky in #9368
* Stop placeholder textures from forcing shader recompiles by @mvaligursky in #9592

* Add RigidBodyComponent#gravityScale by @willeastcott in #9465

summary:
## 🌟 Summary
**v8.4.171 adds end-to-end AMD GPU support for Ultralytics workflows, alongside fixes to dataset handling, model export, and several task-specific behaviors.**

## 📊 Key Changes
- **AMD ROCm and MIGraphX support (PR #24137):** Train and run native PyTorch models on supported AMD GPUs with ROCm, and run exported ONNX models using the MIGraphX execution provider. Provider selection is automatic on supported systems, with CPU fallback if MIGraphX is unavailable.
- **AMD deployment options:** Adds a ROCm-based `latest-amd` Docker image, AMD GPU CI testing, and setup and usage guidance. MIGraphX support targets Linux x86_64 with Python 3.11 or newer.
- **Faster repeat ONNX startup:** MIGraphX compiled models are cached, avoiding recompilation on later loads. Published Radeon 8060S benchmarks show matching accuracy and faster inference for ONNX/MIGraphX than PyTorch ROCm in the tested configurations; the first run still incurs compilation time.
- **Dataset and training fixes:** Restores reading existing image caches across cache modes, preserves archive timestamps to avoid unnecessary label rescans, and corrects RT-DETR denoising query matching during training.
- **Export and task fixes:** Reduces temporary storage used by Core ML NMS exports, improves pose keypoint scaling in LiteRT/RKNN, and fixes several mask and analytics behaviors.
- **Documentation and CI improvements:** Adds Apple M4 Core AI/Core ML latency results and suppresses expected tracer warnings in pytest logs.

## 🎯 Purpose & Impact
- **More hardware choice:** AMD users can train with ROCm and deploy ONNX models with GPU acceleration through MIGraphX, without changing their usual prediction calls.
- **Smoother deployment:** The AMD Docker image and dedicated setup documentation make it easier to get started, while hardware CI helps verify the ROCm path.
- **More reliable workflows:** Cache and training fixes help avoid wasted disk space, repeated dataset processing, and incorrect RT-DETR denoising matches.
- **No new model architecture is introduced:** The headline change is broader AMD hardware support, with additional bug fixes and clearer performance guidance.

## What's Changed
* Fix regressions found in third-party PR audits by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26461
* Add Core ML and Core AI latency benchmarks on Apple M4 to the Core AI docs by @onuralpszr in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26459
* Remove extra temporary weights copy from CoreML NMS export by @amanharshx in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26466
* Fix RT-DETR contrastive denoising group indices by @Nikhi00718 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26465
* Ignore benign TracerWarnings in pytest like the package does by @UltralyticsAssistant in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/26462
* Add AMD ROCm and MIGraphX support by @itikhono in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/24137

## New Contributors
* @itikhono made their first contribution in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/24137

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/compare/v8.4.170...v8.4.171
